purpose: Convert population-scale person-kilometres into a transparent, replaceable relative resource-pressure ledger so policy candidates can be compared without claiming local energy use or greenhouse-gas emissions.

unit_definition.intensity_unit: relative energy-intensity index per passenger-kilometre, normalized to car = 1.0
unit_definition.screen_output: known-mode person-km × declared relative intensity; enterprise shuttle remains an explicit unknown until fleet, fuel, occupancy and route evidence are available
unit_definition.not_an_absolute_measure: The output is not kWh, MJ, gCO2e, fuel use, local inventory or a procurement target. Replace the method factors with dated local factors before any environmental or operational decision.

selection_boundary: This screen is a separate resource-pressure sensitivity readout. It is not used to rank O1/O2/O3/O4, and a lower relative index cannot override capacity, accessibility, safety, privacy or human-service gates.
calibration_required: dated metro electricity and traction-energy accounting boundary
bus and shuttle fuel or electricity type, vehicle-kilometres and occupancy
car fleet composition, occupancy and external-commute share
local passenger-kilometres by 15-minute slice and group
life-cycle boundary decision if construction, batteries or embodied carbon are included
independent environmental review before any absolute CO2e or energy claim
privacy: Only group × mode × policy aggregates are retained; no individual route, address, employer identity or vehicle identifier is published.
